Select: molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, canonical_smiles. Source: molecule_dictionary, docs, compound_structures. Join: molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_records.molregno; compound_records.doc_id = docs.doc_id; molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter: docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1122107'. Sort: molecule_chembl_id ascending.
